title: OSC announced $620 million conditional commitment to Vulcan
summary: The Office of Strategic Capital announced a separate $620 million conditional loan commitment to Vulcan Elements within a joint $700 million package.

sources.title: Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment

data.name: Vulcan Elements OSC conditional loan commitment
data.description: OSC announced separate conditional commitments of $620 million to Vulcan Elements and $80 million to ReElement Technologies.
data.outcome: Conditional commitment announced; public announcement did not establish disbursement.

caveats: A conditional commitment is not equivalent to a closed or disbursed loan.
